message.content: The title of “best” can vary depending on criteria—critical acclaim, awards, audience reception, or personal taste—but many agree that **“Parasite”** (2019) was the standout film of 2020. It won the Academy Award for Best Picture and was praised worldwide for its sharp social commentary, genre-blending storytelling, and masterful direction by Bong Joon‑ho. If you’re looking for something else, other highly regarded releases include “1917,” “Joker,” and “Soul.”
